item.title: What I Want From a Retro Machine
item.description: My problem is that I’m hardly picky. So I tried to narrow it down: Mega Drive-class graphics, no line numbers, and hardware I can actually PEEK and POKE. Here’s how the X16, MEGA65, C64U, and Agon stack up, and why I’m probably starting with a 6502 on a breadboard anyway.

item.title: Purity Was Never Real
item.description: Some retro fans say FPGAs ruin the hobby, and that the C64U is killing it. But the machines they love were built on custom chips and programmable logic from day one, and the 8-bit world was never one big happy family. Here’s my take on the purity arguments, and why most of them judge the wrong thing.
